_about: Everyone a slice quest places who has no quest topic of their own (owner walk 4, 2026-11-08: everyone in the places the slice quests touch has dialogue). One reply each to the prompt, built into ARG_Talk (QuestPeople in Talk.cs) gated GetIsID to the base; 'when' gates it on a quest's stage (lo inclusive, hi exclusive).

lines: I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. I owe months on the broker's roll, like the rest of this gang. Be quiet while Ux-Xeek reads the roll.
I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. The roll burned in the fire, so I cannot show what I owe now. I do not know yet if that is good for me.
Ri'Sakka. This one owes months to the broker on the pier. The overseer adds more months for every meal. This one eats only when it must.
Ri'Sakka. This one ran when the huts burned. The roll is ash now. This one is wet and hungry.
Tsanji. This one works off the broker's months, like you. Stay close to the gang. Do not wander off the path.
Tsanji. This one saw a tall woman with a knotted cord at her wrist. She led the ones who set the fire.
Llarvi Maryon. I owe months to the broker, the same as you, outlander. The overseer feeds us and puts the bread on the roll.
Llarvi Maryon. The roll burned with the camp, so I cannot show what I owed. I will go back to Lilmoth and see whether the broker's men try to collect.
We go to the camp at the edge of the paddies on Hereguard Plantation. The broker has hired you out to work there. Keep up with the gang.
I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. We walk to the camp on Hereguard Plantation now. Stay with the gang on the path.
Mee-Tuja. I carry a satchel upriver. I walk with your gang as far as the camp. I will not say whose satchel it is.
I am Sal-Sei. I keep the clutch of eggs at the roots of the Hist cutting from Nine Bends. Do not go near the eggs.
I am Sal-Sei. I kept the clutch of eggs. The roots of the Hist cutting were cut before its light went out. The eggs are grey now.
I am Deesh-Duun. I owe months on the roll, like you. I want to be off the roll and out of the broker's hire.
I am Deesh-Duun. A tall woman with a knotted cord at her wrist led the ones who attacked us. I saw her face. She let me live.
I am Nesh-Neel. My family works off its months here, like the rest of the gang. Sit by the fire when Ux-Xeek reads the roll.
You do not need my name. Go and sit by your fire.
I am Salts-The-Catch. I sell fish in Lilmoth, and I keep this house. If you were sent for, go in. If you were not, go back to the dock.
You do not know me. If you were at the Hereguard camp, a person in Lilmoth wants to hear about it. I will say no more.
Hides-His-Wake. I work this camp, and I do not talk about it with strangers. Go back the way you came.
Counts-The-Jars. I tend the jars of sap at this camp. You have no business here. Go.
I work for the estate. I walk this landing at night. The landing belongs to the estate. So do the boats tied to it. Keep walking.
I keep this gate for the heirs. The stone house is their outer post. Only those with their word may go in. Do you have it? Then go.
I am a lookout. I watch the stair and the water. If you have business here, talk to Bent-Spine, not to me.
I am a lookout. I watch the water. If you came down the trapdoor, Bent-Spine has been told.
